intro: The Defias Brotherhood is a widespread criminal network of bandits, brigands, and assassins waging an underground insurgency against the Kingdom of Stormwind. Originally formed by the artisans of the Stonemasons Guild who were cheated of their pay for rebuilding the capital, they have devolved into violent outlaws terrorizing the southern farmlands. From their hidden redoubt deep beneath Westfall, they aim to overthrow the corrupt House of Nobles and lay waste to the kingdom.

p: Following the Second War, the Stonemasons Guild was hired to rebuild Stormwind from smoldering ruins into a grand stone capital. When their masterwork was finished, the House of Nobles refused to deliver the promised payment, citing crushing wartime debt. Guildmaster Edwin VanCleef spoke out on behalf of his workers, demanding fair restitution, but the nobles responded by ordering the Stonemasons Guild disbanded. The ensuing riots in the city streets ended with the laborers driven out of Stormwind into exile. Stripped of their livelihood and outlawed, VanCleef and the desperate workers banded together, binding their faces in red silk to represent the blood of the wronged, and turned to highway robbery to claim what they believed they were owed.

With the royal army overextended, VanCleef turned the neglected farmlands of Westfall into the Brotherhood's base of operations. The bandits overran the hamlet of Moonbrook and commandeered the abandoned subterranean tunnels of the Deadmines. Defias agents seized local mines, driven farmers from their homesteads with reprogrammed harvest golems, and salted the earth to starve the region. With the Crown unable or unwilling to send soldiers to protect rural citizens, local farmers formed The People's Militia out of Sentinel Hill to fight a desperate war of attrition against an enemy that now outmans and outguns them.
